title: Deposit rental bonds with the Secretary
what: Deposit each residential rental bond received with the Secretary within the deposit period, with a notice in the approved form.

sources.title: Residential Tenancies Act 2010 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A landlord, landlord's agent or other person who receives an amount of rental bond must deposit that amount with the Secretary within the deposit period together with a notice in the approved form

reach.condition: if it lets residential premises and takes a rental bond
